title: Deserialization and template engines

atom_notes.A01: a deserializer or template engine is an interpreter that accepts structured input
atom_notes.A11: the gadget comes from a dependency, so the classpath or composer lock is part of the attack surface
atom_notes.A05: the serializer format is shape, and shape confusion is how a payload survives validation

required_cells.why: identify the sink and the dependency set before choosing a chain
confirm the sink with a benign probe before a gadget
the chain is the exploitation step
a callback from the target process is the only acceptable proof
retest after a library upgrade, which is the actual fix

preconditions: templates or resources are selected by locale or name

tree.q: Do you know where the serialized data is deserialized?
tree.why: This is the sink question again, and it matters more here because a gadget without a sink is a curiosity and a sink without a gadget is a dead end. Both are needed and neither alone is a finding.

branches.action: find code that deserializes: cookies, viewstate, cache values, queue messages, session blobs. read the client serializer if present
branches.oracle: a location where attacker controlled bytes are deserialized

branches.action: inspect the bytes. magic, length prefixes and type tags identify the format without guessing
enumerate the classpath, match a gadget, prove with a callback
composer lock or machineKey first, then the matching chain tool
arithmetic first, never a shell payload. 7*7 is the only safe first test

mirror.control: allowlist types, never deserialize untrusted bytes
no unserialize of user data, or allowed_classes
logic-less templates, no user template source

gaps.gap: No tool that maps a sink to the reachable gadget set automatically from a lockfile
gaps.build_candidate: parse composer.lock or a jar list, intersect with a gadget database, emit reachable chains per sink

gaps.gap: No safe SSTI prober that never sends an execution payload
gaps.build_candidate: arithmetic only with a control that must not evaluate
replay the proving chain after the dependency upgrade

status_note: AUTHORED. The class where the gadget is not the finding.
